title: Original pumpkin histories through the installed workspace
summary: Continuation with exact original committed source journals restored to the isolated copy. Three original pumpkin histories, read-only navigation and unchanged evidence are checked.

manualSteps.label: Workspace
manualSteps.instruction: Open the proof workspace and click Workflows.

manualSteps.label: History
manualSteps.instruction: Open each original pumpkin workflow link with its exact saved run.

manualSteps.label: Return
manualSteps.instruction: Click Back to workflow, then View saved result.

manualSteps.label: Saved record
manualSteps.instruction: Click Open saved run record and inspect its workspace file tab.

steps.label: Installed workspace entry
steps.summary: Normal Wright workspace loads from the current installed wheel.

steps.label: Shared authoring entry
steps.summary: Established workflow editor remains; active vendor demo entry is absent.
steps.expected: Editor controls without active print demo.
steps.actual: Editor controls present; Print a part demo absent.

steps.label: Original failed pumpkin — exact history
steps.summary: Original failed recorder and 3 result identities are preserved.
steps.purpose: Preserve original format and exact evidence.
steps.expected: Exact recorded run/status/error and result links; no execution controls.
steps.actual: 997873e33f2143ac90d6bfb9fe02c2e2; failed; 3 exact results and 3 artifact links.

steps.label: Original failed pumpkin — editor return
steps.summary: History returns to its exact saved source.

steps.label: Original failed pumpkin — read-only reopen
steps.summary: Same retained history reopens without a new run.

steps.summary: Exact original recorder opens inside Wright.
steps.expected: Exact recorder tab selected; no external window.
